prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) snow-laden fir tree; 2) small snowy fir; 3) snow-covered boulder; 4) stack of firewood under snow; 5) wooden sled; 6) frozen stone well with icicles; 7) snowman-free snow bank mound; 8) ice crystal formation; 9) iron stove chimney pipe (unlit); 10) wooden ice-fishing hole frame; 11) snowy wooden fence; 12) barrel with snow on top; 13) hanging lantern post with snow (unlit); 14) reindeer-free hay sled with sacks; 15) icicle-covered signpost (blank).
Scale: trees are about 60-70 art pixels tall, small items about 16-24 art pixels; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a transparent-background sprite sheet of EXACTLY 15 distinct, isolated winter-environment props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG. Canvas organized in THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, in strict reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Broad transparent gutters around every item, all silhouettes completely contained within their cell, nothing touching any other item or canvas edge. The 15 cells, in order: row 1: (1) tall snow-laden fir tree, (2) smaller snowy fir tree, (3) snow-covered boulder; row 2: (4) tidy stacked firewood beneath snow, (5) wooden sled, (6) frozen circular stone well with icicles; row 3: (7) simple snowbank mound, NO snowman, (8) angular ice crystal formation, (9) unlit iron stove chimney pipe; row 4: (10) wooden ice-fishing-hole frame with a dark hole, (11) short snowy wooden fence, (12) barrel topped with snow; row 5: (13) snow-covered hanging lantern post with UNLIT lantern, (14) small hay sled carrying sacks, NO reindeer, (15) blank icicle-covered wooden signpost, NO lettering. Perspective is classic three-quarter top-down RPG environmental sprites: visible upper and front surfaces, objects upright with base/feet at bottom. Trees are approximately 60–70 underlying art pixels tall; small objects approximately 16–24 underlying art pixels tall. Premium hand-crafted HD pixel-art JRPG aesthetic. All underlying pixels are hard-edged and consistently sized uniform squares (~8 image pixels per art pixel), with discrete 3–10-pixel clusters, clear intentional silhouettes; absolutely no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, gradients, photo textures, noise or dithering. Rich earthy lived-in palette, 4–6 distinct shades per material, hue-shifted ramps with saturated purplish/red shadows and warm yellow-tinted highlights. Soft even neutral upper-left overcast lighting in clean base colors: no cast shadows, no ground, no ambient ground patches, no glow, no emitted light, no light pools, no vignette, no nighttime darkness. Truly transparent alpha background; no checkerboard backdrop. No numbers, labels, text, frames, or dividers.
